theorem lg_target : StrictMonoOn Int.natAbs (Set.Ici 0) := by
  have h_natAbs_id : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ici 0, Int.natAbs x = x := by
    intro x hx
    cases hx with n hn
    rw [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hn]
    exact Nat.cast_eq_cast_iff.mpr hn

  have h_strict_mono_id : StrictMonoOn (fun x => x) (Set.Ici 0) := by
    intros x y hxy
    exact hxy

  refine StrictMonoOn.congr (fun x => x) Int.natAbs h_natAbs_id h_strict_mono_id
